To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a dynamic capability can be developed by combining a managerial process with organisational processes.

a dynamic capability requires three sets of activities: the first set is the identification and acquisition of resources; the second set is the integration of resources; the third set is the creation and exploitation of resources.

dynamic capabilities are developed through the following three activities: 1) top managers must be able to coordinate and align the activities of the organisation in order to create a new business model, 2) the organisation must be able to acquire and integrate new knowledge in order to create new products and services, and 3) the firm must be able to create and exploit new knowledge in order for this knowledge to be used to create a new competitive advantage.

the development of dynamic capabilities and the organisational and managerial activities that are required to achieve them.

dynamic capabilities can be developed through organisational and/or managerial processes and that the three sets of processes are essential to the development of dynamic capabilities.
